quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا
يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا
وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًۭا
وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا
وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًۭا
وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًۭا
وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَشُهُبًۭا
وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًۭا رَّصَدًۭا
وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا
وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًۭا
وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًۭا وَلَا رَهَقًۭا
وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًۭا
وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًۭا
وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًۭا
لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًۭا صَعَدًۭا
وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًۭا
وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًۭا
قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا
قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا رَشَدًۭا
قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
إِلَّا بَلَٰغًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًۭا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًۭا
قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًۭا
لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا

parent_channels.name: P1: Concealed Dispatch Becomes Epistemic Commitment

subchannels.name: Hidden transfer enters voice and gathered recitation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Knowledge is conveyed covertly, encoded or signaled, gathered into a recitable object, voiced, heard by a small mobilized group, and recognized as extraordinary.
subchannels.active_motifs: covert transfer of knowledge (`quranic:root_001633:B001/m01`); sign or gesture (`quranic:root_001633:B002/m01`); writing and inscription (`quranic:root_001633:B003/m01`); divine inspiration (`quranic:root_001633:B004/m01`); low hidden sound (`quranic:root_001633:B005/m01`); gathering into a whole (`quranic:root_001210:B001/m01`); reading and recitation (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); auditory reception (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); making another hear (`quranic:root_000741:B004/m01`); spoken utterance (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); a small group that rises to a summons (`quranic:root_001532:B003/m01`); wonder at the unfamiliar (`quranic:root_000984:B001/m01`); attraction through perceived excellence (`quranic:root_000984:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 72:1 أُوحِىَ, ٱسْتَمَعَ/سَمِعْ, نَفَرٌ, قُرْءَانًا, قُلْ/قَالُ, عَجَبًا.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene begins with content delivered out of sight and allows several materializations of that hidden transfer: sign, inscription, and quiet sound. The root of recitation adds collection before vocalization, while hearing supplies the receiving operation and the group's speech supplies public uptake. Wonder is therefore not an isolated reaction; it marks the point at which a concealed dispatch has survived encoding, gathering, voicing, and reception.

subchannels.name: Hearing becomes direction, comprehension, and secure assent
subchannels.scene_or_process: Received sound is understood and obeyed, takes the form of a leading direction, reaches a sound course of action, and settles as trust rather than mere acoustic contact.
subchannels.active_motifs: understanding and compliance after hearing (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); gentle direction toward a road or truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); an affair's orientation and manner (`quranic:root_001583:B002/m01`); a guide or leading front (`quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`); a straight route away from error (`quranic:root_000565:B001/m01`); sound practical judgment (`quranic:root_000565:B002/m01`); inward security and trust (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); assent that quiets the heart (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Hearing is extended from a bodily event into an ordered transition: comprehension, compliance, orientation, and practical judgment. The guide can be both a person at the front and the leading edge of a moving body, so the heard message does not merely indicate a road; it reorganizes the hearer into a following position. Faith is the resulting settled trust, not a second, unrelated theme.

subchannels.name: Speech detaches from evidence and becomes injurious attribution
subchannels.scene_or_process: Unstable judgment produces excessive or deviant speech, which circulates as hearsay and finally attributes to another words or realities that were never established.
subchannels.active_motifs: lightness and agitation (`quranic:root_000717:B001/m01`); deficient judgment (`quranic:root_000717:B002/m01`); declaring a person or view foolish (`quranic:root_000717:B004/m01`); excessive distance beyond a limit (`quranic:root_000795:B001/m01`); deviation from truth in judgment (`quranic:root_000795:B002/m01`); fabricated attribution (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); circulating talk (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`); an unvoiced proposition in the mind (`quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`); a proposition hardened into doctrine (`quranic:root_001272:B013/m01`); falsehood opposed to truth (`quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`); charging another with falsehood (`quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`); deceptive appearance (`quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The operation is not simply "bad speech." Mental lightness destabilizes judgment; distance and lateral deviation remove a claim from the truth; private formulation then becomes public circulation and false attribution. The deceptive cloth that misstates its own condition gives the process a material endpoint: an utterance can present a patterned surface that does not correspond to what it covers.

subchannels.name: Assumption is forced back into acknowledged uncertainty
subchannels.scene_or_process: Strong belief, weak surmise, suspicion, and unreliable expectation are distinguished until the speakers explicitly admit that another's intended outcome remains unknown.
subchannels.active_motifs: conviction inferred from an indicator (`quranic:root_000969:B001/m01`); weak surmise (`quranic:root_000969:B003/m01`); accusation and suspicion (`quranic:root_000969:B004/m01`); habitual mistrust (`quranic:root_000969:B005/m01`); an outcome that cannot be relied upon (`quranic:root_000969:B006/m01`); knowledge and making known (`quranic:root_000473:B001/m01`); intention and volition (`quranic:root_000610:B001/m01`); evil or harmful outcome (`quranic:root_000787:B001/m01`); rectifying direction (`quranic:root_000565:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The same root can name conviction, conjecture, accusation, or an expectation whose end is insecure. The scene therefore sorts epistemic states rather than treating all belief alike. At 72:10 the sorting terminates in a disciplined admission: the observed closure of the sky does not disclose whether harm or rectification is intended.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A message moves through controlled stages from hidden transmission to audible form, understanding, and committed response; failure occurs when speech detaches from that chain.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 72:1-5 and 72:10,13 anchor revelation, listening, recitation, speech, belief, conjecture, falsehood, and unresolved intention.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The lexical network treats revelation less as a static text than as a custody chain whose successive operations can be contrasted with the uncontrolled manufacture and circulation of claims.

parent_channels.name: P1: Exclusive Sovereignty Closes Household Succession

subchannels.name: Rule is neither acquired nor shared
subchannels.scene_or_process: A possessor acquires and governs an object, but the asserted sovereignty is elevated beyond acquisition, negotiated partnership, or division into shares.
subchannels.active_motifs: lordship, possession, and command (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); nurture and completion under a governor (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); taking into one's possession (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`); acquisition for oneself (`quranic:root_000018:B010/m01`); partnership and shared share (`quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`); assigning a partner to God (`quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`); singularity (`quranic:root_000017:B001/m01`); exhaustive exclusion of any participant (`quranic:root_000017:B002/m01`); elevation (`quranic:root_001042:B001/m01`); rank and honor (`quranic:root_001042:B002/m01`); prevailing mastery (`quranic:root_001042:B004/m01`); greatness of standing (`quranic:root_000227:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Taking and partnership describe ordinary ways in which a domain is acquired, divided, and jointly administered. Singularity and exhaustive negation close those routes, while elevation and greatness place the Lord beyond the social mechanics by which a human ruler secures or extends possession. Nurture remains active, but it proceeds from sovereignty rather than producing it.

subchannels.name: The consort-to-lineage chain is denied in full
subchannels.scene_or_process: Companionship can become marriage, marriage can establish a household, the womb can conceal and gather a fetus, and birth can continue a line; the surface denial cuts this entire chain.
subchannels.active_motifs: companionship and sustained association (`quranic:root_000844:B001/m01`); making something a continuing companion (`quranic:root_000844:B004/m01`); a child growing into a companion (`quranic:root_000844:B005/m01`); marital partnership (`quranic:root_000791:B003/m01`); a stepchild and household guardian (`quranic:root_000532:B005/m01`); a bride conveyed to a husband (`quranic:root_001583:B006/m01`); a fetus concealed in the womb (`quranic:root_000266:B007/m01`); a womb gathering a pregnancy (`quranic:root_001210:B004/m01`); offspring (`quranic:root_001683:B001/m01`); parenthood (`quranic:root_001683:B002/m01`); parturition (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`); a newborn or young dependent (`quranic:root_001683:B004/m01`); generation of one thing from another (`quranic:root_001683:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Lexical branches supply the stages suppressed by the terse surface negation: association, marital transfer, household incorporation, concealment in a womb, delivery, and derived continuation. Because these are successive operations rather than a list of family terms, the channel sharpens the claim: divine sovereignty neither originates in a household alliance nor persists through reproductive succession.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Possession, partnership, household formation, and biological continuation are alternative mechanisms for extending authority, and the pericope denies that the Lord's exalted rule depends on any of them.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 72:2-3 anchors non-partnership, lordship, exaltation, taking a consort, and offspring.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The denial of consort and child is expanded into a complete social and reproductive chain, from acquisition and marriage through gestation, birth, and derivative continuation.

parent_channels.name: P1: Refuge Brokerage Reverses into Encroachment

subchannels.name: Visible and hidden collectives enter a protection relation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Human clients approach hidden parties represented as socially legible men, and ask those parties to function as protectors.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible humanity opposed to wild hiddenness (`quranic:root_000059:B001/m01`); familiarity that removes estrangement (`quranic:root_000059:B003/m01`); close companion or confidant (`quranic:root_000059:B006/m01`); concealment from perception (`quranic:root_000266:B001/m01`); hidden jinn (`quranic:root_000266:B005/m01`); a massed hidden community (`quranic:root_000266:B013/m01`); adult male social standing (`quranic:root_000546:B002/m01`); flight to a protector (`quranic:root_001059:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The encounter crosses the visible-hidden divide but preserves an ordinary social grammar: clients, recognized male brokers, and a request for protection. The human root contributes familiarity and companionship, while the jinn root contributes concealment and a hidden collective. The result is not an abstract superstition but a failed patronage arrangement between two represented communities.

subchannels.name: Protective devices become means of restraint
subchannels.scene_or_process: A charm, amulet, shield, hidden place, or divinatory procedure is installed to ward off danger, yet the same apparatus can immobilize judgment or hold its user.
subchannels.active_motifs: an incantation or bead that restrains marriage or opinion (`quranic:root_000018:B004/m01`); amulet and protective recitation (`quranic:root_001059:B002/m01`); a shield used for defense (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); a hiding place (`quranic:root_000266:B017/m01`); a covenant of protection (`quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`); divination by pebbles or traced marks (`quranic:root_000932:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The protective field is materially complete: spoken formula, portable amulet, shield, hiding place, covenant, and divinatory reading. The crucial reversal is already present inside the evidence: the charm that should secure its bearer can instead bind a person or arrest a decision. That reversal prepares the surface outcome in which recourse to hidden protectors increases rather than relieves exposure.

subchannels.name: Added protection becomes pursuit, crowding, and overload
subchannels.scene_or_process: The requested supplement exceeds measure, draws the client closer to capture, and imposes a burden beyond capacity.
subchannels.active_motifs: increase and accretion (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); overstatement beyond proportion (`quranic:root_000657:B003/m01`); bidding for still more (`quranic:root_000657:B004/m01`); an affliction that overtakes and dominates (`quranic:root_000606:B001/m01`); pursuit until nearly caught (`quranic:root_000606:B002/m01`); coercive overburdening (`quranic:root_000606:B003/m01`); time compressed toward expiry (`quranic:root_000606:B004/m01`); transgressive excess (`quranic:root_000606:B005/m01`); a man crowded by guests and petitioners (`quranic:root_000606:B006/m01`); mutual dependence that fails in battle (`quranic:root_001059:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Increase is not neutral quantity. It becomes escalation, near capture, shortened time, and imposed difficulty, while the crowded host gives the burden a social body. The parties who should protect one another instead reproduce the battlefield failure in which each seeks shelter in the other and no one bears the risk.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A protection relation should place a vulnerable party within another's shelter, but the human-jinn arrangement reverses the roles and enlarges the very pressure it was meant to contain.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 72:5-6 anchors human and jinn parties, male intermediaries, seeking refuge, increase, and encroaching burden.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Refuge appears as a social contract, a physical enclosure, and an occult appliance; every form is vulnerable to capture by the broker who claims to provide it.

parent_channels.name: P1: Sky Listening Becomes a Reversed Hunt

subchannels.name: Reconnaissance discovers a saturated fortification
subchannels.scene_or_process: An exploratory approach makes contact with the upper enclosure and discovers that its available volume has been occupied by a hardened guard force.
subchannels.active_motifs: tactile contact (`quranic:root_001377:B001/m01`); repeated search and solicitation (`quranic:root_001377:B002/m01`); the covering sky (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); setting out to hunt (`quranic:root_000745:B006/m01`); finding the sought object (`quranic:root_001626:B001/m01`); fullness equal to capacity (`quranic:root_001441:B001/m01`); active guarding (`quranic:root_000307:B001/m01`); tightened fastening (`quranic:root_000782:B001/m01`); force and hardness (`quranic:root_000782:B002/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 72:8 لَمَسْ, سَّمَآءَ, وَجَدْ, مُلِئَتْ, حَرَسًا, شَدِيدًا.
subchannels.synthesis: Touch is paired with repeated seeking, so contact with the sky reads as reconnaissance rather than passive sensation. Fullness turns the sky into an occupied container, guarding supplies personnel, and tightening supplies fortification. The hunters' upward search thus terminates at a boundary whose capacity has already been claimed.

subchannels.name: The listening blind is itself trapped
subchannels.scene_or_process: A watcher sits in concealment to intercept sound, but the route and station have already been prepared as an ambush and snare.
subchannels.active_motifs: fixed sitting place (`quranic:root_001244:B001/m01`); sitting in surveillance (`quranic:root_001244:B005/m01`); auditory capture (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); the ear as receiving aperture (`quranic:root_000741:B002/m01`); watch and ambush (`quranic:root_000566:B001/m01`); prepared allocation (`quranic:root_000566:B002/m01`); a designated watch-place or trap (`quranic:root_000566:B003/m01`); hunter's snare (`quranic:root_000791:B006/m01`); set trap (`quranic:root_000932:B013/m01`); stalking behind cover (`quranic:root_000473:B003/m01`); defensive screen (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Sitting, watching, and listening define a concealed observation post. The trap branches reverse its direction: the same route on which the listener waits is a prepared capture point, and the hunter's blind becomes the defender's snare. This role reversal explains the abrupt replacement of access by interception without reducing the scene to generic "security."

subchannels.name: A bright projectile performs the interception
subchannels.scene_or_process: The defended post launches a brilliant moving flame with the force of a combatant or charge.
subchannels.active_motifs: brilliant flame or falling meteor (`quranic:root_000821:B002/m01`); warrior advancing in battle (`quranic:root_000821:B003/m01`); mixed light and darkness on the projectile (`quranic:root_000821:B001/m01`); flying sparks (`quranic:root_000787:B003/m01`); cutting and scattering under impact (`quranic:root_000787:B004/m01`); a forceful charge (`quranic:root_000782:B003/m01`); a group rising to battle (`quranic:root_001532:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The interceptor combines optical, thermal, and martial roles. Its mixed brightness gives it visible form, sparks supply dispersing fragments, and charge and warrior imagery give it directed agency. The flame is therefore not scenery around the guard system but the system's moving strike.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Seekers approach an upper listening ground as hunters, but the defended boundary converts their observation post into a prepared ambush against them.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 72:8-10 anchors touching the sky, finding it filled with strong guards and flames, seated listening stations, interception, and uncertainty about the purpose of the closure.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The sky defense is assembled from reconnaissance, stalking, blinds, snares, prepared stations, and projectile force, making the listeners both hunters and hunted.

parent_channels.name: P1: A Community Is Sorted into Cuts, Tracks, and Measured Alignment

subchannels.name: One collective is cut into distinct routes
subchannels.scene_or_process: A previously gathered body is split lengthwise into strips and factions, each of which takes a repeated track or manner.
subchannels.active_motifs: an extended route or manner (`quranic:root_000932:B002/m01`); layer placed over layer (`quranic:root_000932:B007/m01`); one trace following another (`quranic:root_000932:B009/m01`); habitual procedure (`quranic:root_000932:B010/m01`); longitudinal cutting (`quranic:root_001204:B001/m01`); divergent factions and methods (`quranic:root_001204:B004/m01`); discriminating division and management (`quranic:root_001204:B005/m01`); cutting across open country (`quranic:root_001204:B006/m01`); visible colored bands and tracks (`quranic:root_000227:B005/m01`); a level road surface (`quranic:root_000227:B007/m01`); repair opposed to corruption (`quranic:root_000876:B001/m01`); reconciliation after estrangement (`quranic:root_000876:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The community is not merely plural. Longitudinal cutting produces distinct strips; visible bands make the division perceptible; repeated tracks convert each strip into a sustained practice. Repair and reconciliation remain possible operations on this divided material, so difference need not be identical with permanent rupture.

subchannels.name: Rectitude is a searched-for and measured course
subchannels.scene_or_process: A seeker deliberately pursues the best direction, follows a leading guide, tests the route for straightness and balance, and enters it through submission.
subchannels.active_motifs: deliberate search for the soundest option (`quranic:root_000314:B004/m01`); worthiness for the chosen course (`quranic:root_000314:B003/m01`); a straight path away from error (`quranic:root_000565:B001/m01`); sound practical disposal (`quranic:root_000565:B002/m01`); gentle route guidance (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); orientation and manner (`quranic:root_001583:B002/m01`); safety from defect (`quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`); peaceful alignment (`quranic:root_000737:B004/m01`); a ladder or means of ascent (`quranic:root_000737:B006/m01`); surrender and handover (`quranic:root_000737:B012/m01`); equitable allocation (`quranic:root_001224:B001/m01`); straight balance (`quranic:root_001224:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Rectitude is assembled from operations rather than labels: search, orientation, leading, checking, and surrender to the selected course. The ladder sense makes submission an enabling structure rather than inert passivity, while the balance converts justice into a calibration of the path.

subchannels.name: Deviant structure becomes dry combustible stock
subchannels.scene_or_process: A course that bends away from the true line is embodied as warped or desiccated limbs and finally assigned the role of gathered fuel.
subchannels.active_motifs: deviation from the equitable line (`quranic:root_001224:B002/m01`); bent or rigid legs (`quranic:root_001224:B005/m01`); constricted provision (`quranic:root_001224:B010/m01`); gathered firewood (`quranic:root_000335:B001/m01`); a body dried like timber (`quranic:root_000335:B004/m01`); airborne sparks (`quranic:root_000787:B003/m01`); a white barren season (`quranic:root_000821:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The q-s-t contrast moves from moral deviation to bodily geometry: the line is bent, the limbs stiffen, provision contracts, and the result resembles dry timber. Firewood then ceases to be an arbitrary punishment image; it is the material endpoint of a warped and desiccated course.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Collective difference is materialized as longitudinal cuts and traversable tracks, then evaluated by whether a course is straight, balanced, or structurally warped.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 72:11 and 72:14-15 anchor differentiated paths, deliberate pursuit of rectitude, submission, deviation, and fuel.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Social and moral differentiation becomes a fabrication process: material is cut into strips, laid as routes, checked against a straight measure, and rejected as crooked dry stock.

parent_channels.name: P1: Security Settles an Account between Shortfall and Overload

subchannels.name: Trust replaces anticipated harm with inward security
subchannels.scene_or_process: Received guidance produces assent and an inward state that no longer projects or displays approaching harm.
subchannels.active_motifs: inward safety and reliability (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); trusted assent (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`); fear as expectation of injury (`quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`); inducing another's fear (`quranic:root_000447:B002/m01`); visible manifestation of fear (`quranic:root_000447:B005/m01`); comprehension and compliance (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); direction toward truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Security is both an inner quiet and a reliable relation, while fear is both anticipated injury and its outward sign. Hearing understood as compliance supplies the transition between them: trusted assent changes not only a proposition but the hearer's projected relation to future harm.

subchannels.name: The protected party receives neither deduction nor surcharge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claimant's due is weighed and allocated without diminution, predatory addition, or a demand that exceeds capacity.
subchannels.active_motifs: diminution of a right or payment (`quranic:root_000087:B001/m01`); oppressive overburdening (`quranic:root_000606:B003/m01`); engulfing pressure (`quranic:root_000606:B001/m01`); transgressive excess (`quranic:root_000606:B005/m01`); numerical addition (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); an allotted share (`quranic:root_001224:B003/m01`); straight balance (`quranic:root_001224:B004/m01`); a fixed measure (`quranic:root_001224:B007/m01`); constricted household provision (`quranic:root_001224:B010/m01`); equitable judgment (`quranic:root_001224:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Diminution and overload are opposite distortions of one settlement. Share, scale, and fixed quantity define the proper middle, while addition can become a predatory surcharge and constriction can become under-provision. The surface pair "no shortfall and no encroachment" is thus a complete protection against both sides of an unjust account.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Trust is represented as a protected settlement in which neither value nor capacity is reduced and no extra burden is imposed.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 72:2,6 and 72:13-15 anchor faith, fear, diminution, encroaching burden, increase, and equitable or inequitable measure.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The promise attached to faith is framed simultaneously as psychological security and exact accounting, joining the heart's calm to a balanced ledger.

parent_channels.name: P2: Route Mechanics Carry Water or Insert the Deflector into Punishment

subchannels.name: An aligned track becomes an irrigation system
subchannels.scene_or_process: A route is made level and stable, water is made continuously available along it, and abundance spreads as sustaining provision.
subchannels.active_motifs: straightness and evenness (`quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`); the support by which life stands (`quranic:root_001273:B009/m01`); an extended route (`quranic:root_000932:B002/m01`); layered construction (`quranic:root_000932:B007/m01`); successive traffic along one trace (`quranic:root_000932:B009/m01`); giving drink (`quranic:root_000722:B001/m01`); making a permanent water supply available (`quranic:root_000722:B002/m01`); an irrigated share and channel (`quranic:root_000722:B003/m01`); a heavy rain-cloud (`quranic:root_000722:B007/m01`); water itself (`quranic:root_001458:B001/m01`); water appearing and increasing (`quranic:root_001458:B002/m01`); conveying water by pouring or irrigation (`quranic:root_001458:B003/m01`); abundant water and livelihood (`quranic:root_001075:B001/m01`); fertile softness (`quranic:root_001075:B002/m01`); profuse speech-like flow (`quranic:root_001075:B007/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Straightness stabilizes the route, but the route is more than a line: layers form its bed, repeated passage maintains it, and watering converts it into infrastructure. Abundance includes both water and sustaining livelihood; even profuse speech is imaged as flow, allowing the channel to retain a distant resonance with the pericope's continuing message.

subchannels.name: Abundance itself becomes an assay medium
subchannels.scene_or_process: The supplied water is not only consumed; it becomes the medium in which recipients are tested and differentiated.
subchannels.active_motifs: testing metal by fire and a person by trial (`quranic:root_001128:B001/m01`); ordeal and affliction (`quranic:root_001128:B004/m01`); abundant water and provision (`quranic:root_001075:B001/m01`); making water continuously available (`quranic:root_000722:B002/m01`); increase and saturation with water (`quranic:root_001458:B002/m01`); gradual nurture to completion (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The trial is structurally joined to abundance: water supplies the surrounding medium in which conduct is exposed, much as fire reveals the quality of metal. Nurture and assay therefore coexist; plentiful provision can complete a subject or disclose its composition.

subchannels.name: Side-turning is threaded into a rising constriction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A subject presents its side and blocks the offered orientation, is inserted into a narrow passage, and experiences punishment as a steep ascent and labored breath.
subchannels.active_motifs: turning away by presenting one's side (`quranic:root_001001:B005/m01`); interception and blockage (`quranic:root_001001:B004/m01`); indirect or two-faced expression (`quranic:root_001001:B010/m01`); remembered content held in the heart (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); spoken remembrance (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`); a reminder that restores presence (`quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`); entering and traversing a path (`quranic:root_000735:B001/m01`); inserting one thing into another (`quranic:root_000735:B002/m01`); straight penetrating thrust (`quranic:root_000735:B003/m01`); thread drawn through material (`quranic:root_000735:B004/m01`); an extended border in cloth (`quranic:root_000735:B005/m01`); painful punishment (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); coercive prevention (`quranic:root_000994:B003/m01`); ascent (`quranic:root_000862:B001/m01`); steep obstacle and hardship (`quranic:root_000862:B003/m01`); rising painful breath (`quranic:root_000862:B007/m01`); transformation by heat (`quranic:root_000862:B009/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The side-turn is a bodily refusal of alignment. Insertion then reverses agency: the one who would not enter the route is passed through it like thread or a straight thrust through resistant material. As the passage rises, hardship becomes respiratory and thermal, making "ascending punishment" a constricting process rather than a static place.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Alignment with a route permits sustaining flow, whereas turning a side to the route changes the same conduit into a forced passage toward increasing difficulty.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 72:16-17 anchors straightness on the path, abundant water, testing within it, turning aside, insertion, punishment, and ascent.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Reward and punishment are not two unrelated destinations; both are hydraulic or conduit operations performed on a body in relation to one route.

parent_channels.name: P2: Exclusive Invocation Exposes the Difference between Mass and Support

subchannels.name: Sacred posture and calling converge on one center
subchannels.scene_or_process: A consecrated place gathers lowered bodies and directs vocal appeal toward a single recipient, excluding every partner and rival claimant.
subchannels.active_motifs: prostration and self-lowering (`quranic:root_000675:B001/m01`); place of prostration (`quranic:root_000675:B002/m01`); bodily points of contact in prostration (`quranic:root_000675:B003/m01`); bowed head and body (`quranic:root_000675:B004/m01`); fixed lowered gaze (`quranic:root_000675:B005/m01`); vocal summons (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); claim of right or affiliation (`quranic:root_000478:B002/m01`); worship and the worshiped (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); singularity (`quranic:root_000017:B001/m01`); exhaustive exclusion (`quranic:root_000017:B002/m01`); shared participation (`quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`); religious partnership (`quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Worship is built as a coordinated bodily-vocal scene: feet, knees, hands, face, bowed head, gaze, place, and call all point toward one center. The claim sense of calling clarifies why partnership is excluded: invocation cannot be used to establish a rival title or affiliation within the sacred space.

subchannels.name: A standing servant draws a crowd into layered matter
subchannels.scene_or_process: A servant rises to an act, and surrounding bodies accumulate, compress, and adhere like felt or stacked layers.
subchannels.active_motifs: a human collective (`quranic:root_001273:B001/m01`); bodily standing (`quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`); resolve and rising to an undertaking (`quranic:root_001273:B003/m01`); standing place or station (`quranic:root_001273:B006/m01`); servitude under ownership (`quranic:root_000973:B001/m01`); submissive worship (`quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`); a path flattened for service (`quranic:root_000973:B005/m01`); material matted layer on layer (`quranic:root_001340:B001/m01`); a compressed multitude (`quranic:root_001340:B002/m01`); adhesion to the ground or place (`quranic:root_001340:B003/m01`); successive collapse (`quranic:root_000478:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Standing isolates one upright individual while the crowd loses individual articulation and becomes matted material. The flattened service-road under the servant contrasts with the crowd's adhesion and successive collapse. The scene is thus a geometry of action: one resolved vertical act surrounded by compressed, reactive mass.

subchannels.name: Apparent multitude is decomposed into weak help and low count
subchannels.scene_or_process: When the promised event becomes visible, collective power is evaluated by separating bodily mass from strength, assistance, and number.
subchannels.active_motifs: bodily or strategic weakness (`quranic:root_000909:B001/m01`); multiplication that can merely duplicate quantity (`quranic:root_000909:B002/m01`); aid against an opponent (`quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`); recovery of right after oppression (`quranic:root_001510:B002/m01`); fewness and insignificance (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`); lifting and carrying a burden (`quranic:root_001251:B004/m01`); tremor under fear or anger (`quranic:root_001251:B005/m01`); enumerated membership (`quranic:root_000989:B001/m01`); comparison with a peer counted alongside (`quranic:root_000989:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Quantity can be doubled without producing force, and a member can be counted beside another without becoming a helper. The later measurement therefore undoes the earlier visual impression of the packed crowd: support is a functional relation, not a silhouette, and number does not guarantee the capacity to carry the event.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodies can orient, gather, and pile around a single act of worship, but physical mass does not confer shared divine agency or effective support.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 72:18-20 and 72:24 anchor sacred places, exclusive calling, the standing servant, a layered crowd, weak support, and fewness.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The crowd first appears as compressed material and is later analytically decomposed into capacity and count, reversing the visual impression of overwhelming mass.

parent_channels.name: P2: Delegated Speech Carries No Proprietary Agency

subchannels.name: Harm and rectitude are not the speaker's property
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker disclaims possession, sovereign disposal, and the structural means by which either injury or sound direction could be independently guaranteed.
subchannels.active_motifs: structural cohesion and control (`quranic:root_001444:B001/m01`); legal possession and disposal (`quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`); sovereignty and rule (`quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`); the support on which an affair depends (`quranic:root_001444:B005/m01`); water as the resource that gives a traveler control (`quranic:root_001444:B007/m01`); injury and diminution (`quranic:root_000907:B001/m01`); mutual infliction of injury (`quranic:root_000907:B002/m01`); coercive necessity (`quranic:root_000907:B003/m01`); straight guidance (`quranic:root_000565:B001/m01`); sound disposal (`quranic:root_000565:B002/m01`); lordship (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Ownership is unfolded into title, sovereign power, structural control, and access to the resource that lets a traveler manage his condition. The disclaimer removes each basis of independent agency. Harm and rectitude are not wares in the messenger's hand, nor does he possess the infrastructure that would let him produce either at will.

subchannels.name: No secondary asylum interrupts the principal's claim
subchannels.scene_or_process: The threatened speaker searches for a protector, subordinate alternative, or lateral recess, but every possible shelter is negated.
subchannels.active_motifs: granting asylum and preventing harm (`quranic:root_000275:B003/m01`); exhaustive absence of any protector (`quranic:root_000017:B002/m01`); a lower or nearer alternative (`quranic:root_000502:B001/m01`); someone or something other than the principal (`quranic:root_000502:B003/m01`); finding a sought place (`quranic:root_001626:B001/m01`); deviation from the straight claim (`quranic:root_001345:B001/m01`); a refuge toward which one inclines (`quranic:root_001345:B003/m01`); a lateral edge or recess (`quranic:root_001345:B005/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Asylum normally introduces a third party who can suspend an aggressor's reach. Here the search passes through every lexical alternative: another person, a lower substitute, a different authority, and even a side recess into which one might lean. Their negation leaves no jurisdiction outside the principal's claim.

subchannels.name: The remaining agency is custody and delivery
subchannels.scene_or_process: The messenger receives a carried statement, conveys it until it reaches its endpoint, and is responsible for faithful rather than proprietary control.
subchannels.active_motifs: arrival at an endpoint (`quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`); conveying a message (`quranic:root_000151:B002/m01`); sufficient provision for the journey (`quranic:root_000151:B003/m01`); speech capable of reaching its intended meaning (`quranic:root_000151:B004/m01`); complete performance without shortfall (`quranic:root_000151:B005/m01`); dispatch and release (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); messenger, message, and carried speech (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); deliberate pacing in speech and action (`quranic:root_000563:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Delivery includes a route, adequate provision, effective articulation, and completed arrival. Dispatch releases the carrier, while deliberate pacing protects the content from careless handling. This is real agency, but it is fiduciary: the messenger can carry and complete the transfer without owning what the message will cause.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The messenger has custody of a commission but no ownership title over its outcomes and no independent protection against its source.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 72:20-23 anchors exclusive calling, inability to possess harm or rectitude, lack of protector or refuge, and the exception of conveyance and messages.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Prophetic limitation is expressed through property, indemnity, asylum, and delivery law: no title to effects, no shelter outside the principal, and one bounded duty of transfer.

parent_channels.name: P2: Hidden Knowledge Traverses a Guarded Corridor and Closes as a Ledger

subchannels.name: Disclosure crosses a controlled visibility threshold
subchannels.scene_or_process: Content absent from ordinary sight remains in a concealed domain until an accepted messenger is deliberately allowed to make it manifest.
subchannels.active_motifs: knowledge opposed to ignorance (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); a distinguishing mark that guides (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); concealment from sight and ordinary knowledge (`quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`); a depression in which something disappears (`quranic:root_001117:B002/m01`); a grove that hides its entrant (`quranic:root_001117:B003/m01`); uncertainty within the unseen (`quranic:root_001117:B006/m01`); hidden roots later exposed by digging (`quranic:root_001117:B008/m01`); emergence into visibility (`quranic:root_000970:B001/m01`); gaining access to concealed information (`quranic:root_000970:B008/m01`); placing something behind one's back (`quranic:root_000970:B012/m01`); acceptance and removal of displeasure (`quranic:root_000569:B001/m01`); seeking another's acceptance (`quranic:root_000569:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The hidden is spatially differentiated: buried depth, enclosing growth, and roots below ground all describe forms of nonappearance. Manifestation is therefore controlled crossing, not spontaneous visibility. Acceptance identifies the authorized carrier, while the mark or sign gives that carrier a recognizable route through concealed material.

subchannels.name: The messenger is threaded through a front-and-rear guard line
subchannels.scene_or_process: A dispatched carrier enters a prescribed passage whose forward approach, interior interval, and rear are occupied by prepared watchers.
subchannels.active_motifs: dispatch (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); bearer of carried speech (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); measured progress (`quranic:root_000563:B004/m01`); entering a passage (`quranic:root_000735:B001/m01`); insertion into a channel (`quranic:root_000735:B002/m01`); straight penetration (`quranic:root_000735:B003/m01`); interval between boundaries (`quranic:root_000170:B002/m01`); extended gap or depth (`quranic:root_000170:B006/m01`); separation of an element from its neighbor (`quranic:root_000170:B008/m01`); what lies directly ahead (`quranic:root_001693:B008/m01`); a handle or terminal projection (`quranic:root_001693:B013/m01`); what remains behind (`quranic:root_000433:B002/m01`); a rear guard or delayed group (`quranic:root_000433:B003/m01`); successive replacement (`quranic:root_000433:B006/m01`); active watch (`quranic:root_000566:B001/m01`); prepared allocation (`quranic:root_000566:B002/m01`); designated watch-place (`quranic:root_000566:B003/m01`).
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 72:27 رَّسُولٍ, يَسْلُكُ, بَيْنِ, يَدَيْ, خَلْفِ, رَصَدًا.
subchannels.synthesis: The passage has explicit geometry: front, interval, rear, and terminal edges. The messenger is inserted through it like an object through a prepared channel, while successive guards prevent a temporal gap from opening as the carrier advances. Surveillance is thus distributed along the route rather than concentrated at one gate.

subchannels.name: Delivery closes through enclosure and exact reconciliation
subchannels.scene_or_process: The delivered material reaches its endpoint, is enclosed from every side, and is reconciled as a complete set whose members and provisions are counted.
subchannels.active_motifs: endpoint arrival (`quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`); completed delivery (`quranic:root_000151:B002/m01`); articulation that reaches its object (`quranic:root_000151:B004/m01`); completion without deficiency (`quranic:root_000151:B005/m01`); physical enclosure (`quranic:root_000372:B001/m01`); protective custody (`quranic:root_000372:B002/m01`); total cognitive enclosure (`quranic:root_000372:B004/m01`); overwhelming enclosure that prevents escape (`quranic:root_000372:B006/m01`); counting and exhaustive enumeration (`quranic:root_000332:B002/m01`); rational control of the count (`quranic:root_000332:B003/m01`); totality formed by all parts (`quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`); a surrounding crown or ring (`quranic:root_001315:B005/m01`); a knowable item (`quranic:root_000831:B001/m01`); counted membership (`quranic:root_000989:B001/m01`); readiness and reserve (`quranic:root_000989:B002/m01`); a member compared with its counterpart (`quranic:root_000989:B006/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Arrival alone does not close the chain. Enclosure establishes custody, totality confirms that no part lies outside the set, enumeration reconciles the members, and readiness accounts for what was allocated to the mission. The surrounding crown gives the ledger a spatial analogue: every item lies inside a complete perimeter.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Restricted knowledge is selectively disclosed, routed through a directionally guarded passage, and verified by comprehensive accounting at delivery.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 72:26-28 anchors hidden knowledge, selective disclosure to a messenger, insertion of guards before and behind, completed conveyance, encompassing knowledge, and exact enumeration.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Revelation is modeled as both perimeter security and inventory control: a message has a protected route, a known front and rear, and a reconciled final count.

parent_channels.name: P2: The Promised Event Becomes a Visible and Measurable Horizon

subchannels.name: A verbal commitment becomes an approaching sign
subchannels.scene_or_process: A promise or threat establishes expectation, gives warning signs before arrival, and finally enters the field of sight as a marked event.
subchannels.active_motifs: commitment that opens expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); explicit threat (`quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`); appointed time or place (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); reciprocal appointment (`quranic:root_001662:B004/m01`); a stallion's warning before attack (`quranic:root_001662:B005/m01`); an omen that forecasts a coming condition (`quranic:root_001662:B006/m01`); direct sight (`quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`); two sides coming into mutual view (`quranic:root_000531:B004/m01`); visible appearance or reflected image (`quranic:root_000531:B006/m01`); a raised marker (`quranic:root_000531:B011/m01`); causing another to see (`quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`); knowledge produced by disclosure (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The promised event has a prehistory of signals: commitment, appointment, warning sound, and omen. A raised marker then gives the future a visible coordinate, and mutual visibility changes the relation from one-sided announcement to confrontation with what has arrived.

subchannels.name: Nearness and extent bound the unknown interval
subchannels.scene_or_process: An observer cannot determine whether the event is close, but can still conceive it through approach, temporal ripening, endpoint, capacity, and assigned span.
subchannels.active_motifs: knowledge and acknowledged lack of it (`quranic:root_000473:B001/m01`); spatial nearness (`quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`); temporal approach and ripening (`quranic:root_001212:B002/m01`); a quantity close to fullness (`quranic:root_001212:B016/m01`); final limit or race endpoint (`quranic:root_000050:B001/m01`); a vessel filled with good or harm (`quranic:root_000050:B003/m01`); bringing something into being (`quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`); assigning it a condition or station (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); beginning and continuing an action (`quranic:root_000248:B004/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Nearness is not reduced to a calendar date. It can be a shrinking distance, a crop nearing ripeness, a container nearing fullness, or a runner nearing the finish. The assigned extent fixes that there is a bound even when the observer cannot locate it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A future commitment moves from speech into a perceptible event whose approach, endpoint, and duration can be spatially or quantitatively bounded.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 72:24-25 anchors seeing what was promised, learning at its arrival, uncertainty over nearness, and an assigned extent.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Promise is materialized as animal warning, landmark, race limit, approaching water, and filled capacity, converting future time into a horizon that can be approached and measured.

parent_channels.name: P2: Punishment Becomes Transformed Material and Fixed Residence

subchannels.name: Trial becomes a furnace that alters its subject
subchannels.scene_or_process: A subject is tested, inserted into painful heat, and changed as material is assayed, blackened, melted, or otherwise transformed by fire.
subchannels.active_motifs: assay of metal and person (`quranic:root_001128:B001/m01`); burning and blackening (`quranic:root_001128:B002/m01`); ordeal and affliction (`quranic:root_001128:B004/m01`); conflict generated by trial (`quranic:root_001128:B006/m01`); painful punishment (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); insertion into a medium (`quranic:root_000735:B002/m01`); transformation under heat (`quranic:root_000862:B009/m01`); light and illumination (`quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`); burning fire (`quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`); smoke pigment used as a lasting mark (`quranic:root_001564:B008/m01`); disobedient departure from command (`quranic:root_001022:B001/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: The furnace does not merely surround its subject; it tests composition and produces visible change. Blackening, melting, illumination, and marking are distinct outcomes of one thermal process. Disobedience supplies the movement out of command, while forced insertion returns the subject to a medium that exposes and fixes what it is.

subchannels.name: The transformed state adheres and does not pass
subchannels.scene_or_process: After transformation, the subject remains attached to a place and condition whose duration does not admit departure or ordinary decay.
subchannels.active_motifs: enduring stability (`quranic:root_000429:B001/m01`); clinging and residence (`quranic:root_000429:B002/m01`); a condition fixed in the heart (`quranic:root_000429:B004/m01`); unbounded duration (`quranic:root_000004:B001/m01`); remaining in place without departure (`quranic:root_000004:B006/m01`); an event whose memory persists (`quranic:root_000004:B007/m01`); an emptied dwelling left behind (`quranic:root_000004:B003/m01`).
subchannels.synthesis: Permanence combines duration with adhesion. The subject does not simply last; it clings, resides, and retains a fixed condition, while the enduring event leaves a trace that cannot be forgotten. The deserted-house image adds the inverse perspective: ordinary occupants can leave a place behind, but the surface state of abiding closes that exit.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Disobedience passes through an afflictive transformation and terminates in an attached, enduring state from which ordinary movement or change is suspended.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 72:17 and 72:23 anchor trial, insertion into painful ascent, disobedience, fire, abiding, and perpetuity.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Fire is both an assay and a material-processing operation, while eternity is rendered as adhesion, residence, and an event whose trace cannot disappear.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1: Flight across Exposed Ground Cannot Outrun the Pursuer
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A pursued party attempts speed, concealment, and lateral escape across the earth but cannot outstrip, evade, or disappear from the superior reach.
parent_channels.active_motifs: incapacity to perform (`quranic:root_000985:B001/m01`); failure to outrun or escape pursuit (`quranic:root_000985:B002/m01`); terrified flight (`quranic:root_001585:B001/m01`); disappearance into the ground (`quranic:root_001585:B004/m01`); wind sweeping traces from the surface (`quranic:root_001585:B005/m01`); the lower surface opposed to the sky (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); clinging low to the ground (`quranic:root_000025:B006/m01`); exposing oneself to interception (`quranic:root_000025:B007/m01`); starting a resting body into motion (`quranic:root_000129:B001/m01`); rapid departure (`quranic:root_000129:B004/m01`); recoiling and drawing away (`quranic:root_001532:B001/m01`); finding the sought object (`quranic:root_001626:B001/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Escape is given a complete terrain and motion system: the fugitive is stirred from rest, runs, drops toward the earth, attempts to vanish into it, and relies on wind to erase surface evidence. Failure to outstrip the pursuer defeats each tactic. The surface claim that God cannot be frustrated on earth is thereby materialized as failed evasion rather than generic omnipotence.

parent_channels.name: S2. P1: The Blind Gatherer Turns Hearsay into Tinder
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A night gatherer collects material without discriminating good from bad, carries socially injurious speech, and supplies what will ignite conflict.
parent_channels.active_motifs: blind collection that mixes sound and unsound material (`quranic:root_000335:B002/m01`); carrying gossip that kindles strife (`quranic:root_000335:B003/m01`); fuel gathered for burning (`quranic:root_000335:B001/m01`); circulating talk (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`); excessive speech (`quranic:root_001272:B003/m01`); fabricated attribution (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); falsehood (`quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`); mental lightness (`quranic:root_000717:B001/m01`); deficient judgment (`quranic:root_000717:B002/m01`); nightfall covering the scene (`quranic:root_000266:B002/m01`); a nocturnal arrival (`quranic:root_000932:B001/m01`); flying sparks (`quranic:root_000787:B003/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The night gatherer supplies a precise mechanism for corrupted discourse: poor visibility prevents discrimination, indiscriminate collection becomes excessive circulating talk, and carried gossip becomes combustible social material. The firewood at the pericope's close therefore also resonates backward with the speech failures at its opening.

parent_channels.name: S3. Whole-Surah: A Pebble Oracle Is Measured against Guarded Disclosure
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A seeker solicits hidden counsel through a jinn apparition and a riddling call, while a diviner reads hand-held stones, traced marks, and auspicious signs before an answer is produced.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a jinn apparition offering a divinatory showing (`quranic:root_000531:B008/m01`); riddling calls designed to extract an obscured answer (`quranic:root_000478:B007/m01`); divination by pebbles, finger traces, augury, and soothsaying (`quranic:root_000932:B004/m01`); small pebbles handled as concrete objects (`quranic:root_000332:B001/m01`); a stone large enough to fill the palm (`quranic:root_000565:B004/m01`); exhaustive enumeration that encloses the count (`quranic:root_000332:B002/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The practice assembles an answer-producing apparatus from an intermediary apparition, coded solicitation, stones, and marks that require interpretation. The surah's primary account relocates disclosure from manipulable signs to divine selection and guarded delivery. The pebble/counting hinge sharpens the contrast: the same lexical field that supplies the diviner's stones closes at 72:28 as exact enumeration, pressing recourse to hidden brokers with a count that admits no augural ambiguity.

parent_channels.name: S4. Whole-Surah: A Lute Performance Tests Hearing against Source
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A single lute-note sounds, a singer makes it pleasurable, a co-performer keeps pace, and a low or prolonged sound persists beneath the coordinated performance.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a single note sounded on a lute or similar instrument (`quranic:root_000932:B014/m01`); pleasant singing, beautiful voice, and the singer who produces it (`quranic:root_000741:B007/m01`); a co-performer keeping pace in song (`quranic:root_000563:B008/m01`); a hidden or prolonged nonverbal sound (`quranic:root_001633:B005/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Note, singer, accompanist, and sustained undertone explain how patterned sound can gather and hold attention. This usefully pressures the opening act of hearing: wonder and auditory pleasure do not by themselves establish revelation. The primary reading depends on guidance, authorized source, and guarded delivery, distinguishing coordinated performance from a message whose authority does not arise from its sound.

parent_channels.name: S5. Whole-Surah: The Worked Well Turns Abundance into Access
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A well is dug at pasture, risks being abandoned before water is reached, and becomes a usable supply only when rising water is joined to a pulley, bucket, balanced handle, carrying vessel, and retaining basin.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a pasture well (`quranic:root_000227:B010/m01`); an excavated well abandoned before reaching water (`quranic:root_001244:B015/m01`); water appearing and increasing in a well (`quranic:root_001458:B002/m01`); the standing pulley apparatus at a well (`quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`); a water-carrier's single-handled bucket (`quranic:root_000737:B011/m01`); a bucket or waterskin handle that balances the load (`quranic:root_000741:B008/m01`); a waterskin used to draw and carry water (`quranic:root_001212:B009/m01`); a pit or pool that retains water for days (`quranic:root_000018:B006/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The operation distinguishes the existence of water from access to provision. Excavation can stop short of the source; after water appears, fixed support, fitted lifting parts, a carrier, and a catchment convert it into supply. This materializes 72:16 as completed access rather than ambient plenty: alignment reaches the source and holds what it receives. It also pressures complacency in the trial of 72:17, because abundance remains an entrusted flow whose apparatus and custody must be maintained.

parent_channels.name: S6. Whole-Surah: Milk Is Called, Sent, Diluted, and Lost
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Pregnancy becomes visible in an enlarged udder, a recently delivered ewe is kept for milk, a bowl is fixed for milking, and retained milk draws a successive yield that can be diluted, fail unexpectedly, and finally dry up.
parent_channels.active_motifs: pregnancy made visible by an enlarged udder (`quranic:root_000531:B010/m01`); a ewe recently delivered and kept at home for milk (`quranic:root_000532:B009/m01`); a milking bowl attached to the udder (`quranic:root_001340:B003/m02`); milk retained in the udder to call forth the next flow (`quranic:root_000478:B003/m01`); abundant milk arriving in succession (`quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`); milk diluted with water (`quranic:root_000821:B006/m01`); expected milk "lying" by failing to continue (`quranic:root_001290:B006/m01`); an udder drying as milk is cut off (`quranic:root_000227:B011/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The husbandry sequence gives call, dispatch, visibility, falsehood, and water a single material test. Retained milk "calls" the next flow, the yield is "sent" successively, the udder offers visible expectation, water can adulterate the result, and milk "lies" when continuity fails. This reframes the surah's concern with trustworthy speech and abundant water: a promised flow must arrive, remain undiluted, and endure, while 72:16-17 makes abundance itself the testing medium.

parent_channels.name: S7. Whole-Surah: The Grave Niche Is Concealment, Not Refuge
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Mourners voice grief, the dead person is shrouded and hidden, the body is buried, and a lateral niche is dug to receive it within the grave.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wailing and lament over the dead (`quranic:root_001633:B009/m01`); concealing the dead with shroud and grave (`quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`); burying a body in the grave (`quranic:root_001117:B009/m01`); digging the grave's side niche and placing the dead within it (`quranic:root_001345:B002/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The rite moves from public sound to maximal physical concealment: lament, shroud, burial, and side recess. The same root that names the grave's lateral niche surfaces in 72:22 as the refuge the messenger cannot find. That concrete hinge usefully pressures the primary reading: the body's final recess is confinement rather than asylum, while the burial sense of the unseen places even deliberate concealment within the reach of divine knowledge.

parent_channels.name: S8. P1 (72:8-9) to P2 (72:26-28): Ambush Guard Becomes Escort Guard
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A prepared watch occupies the access route in both intervals, first fixing an unauthorized listener outside as its target and then enclosing an authorized carrier inside as the party whose passage is secured.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sitting in surveillance (`quranic:root_001244:B005/m01`); active watch and ambush (`quranic:root_000566:B001/m01`); a prepared assignment (`quranic:root_000566:B002/m01`); a watch-place, route, or trap (`quranic:root_000566:B003/m01`); messenger, message, and carried speech (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); entering and traversing a prescribed passage (`quranic:root_000735:B001/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The exact watch-root recurs at both ends, so the bridge is a reassignment of one security mechanism. In P1 the stationary outsider waits for sound and discovers that the route has been prepared against him. In P2 the selected messenger moves through the route while the prepared watch occupies front and rear. Authorization reverses the guard's object: it intercepts the illicit seeker but secures the entrusted message.

parent_channels.name: S9. P1 (72:11-15) to P2 (72:16-17): Classified Ways Become an Operative Route
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Plural tracks first classify collective orientations; at the pericope boundary, stance on the route becomes operative, opening supplied water under straightness or forced insertion after a side-turn.
parent_channels.active_motifs: an extended route or manner (`quranic:root_000932:B002/m01`); divergent factions and methods (`quranic:root_001204:B004/m01`); deviation from the equitable line (`quranic:root_001224:B002/m01`); straightness and evenness (`quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`); making a permanent water supply available (`quranic:root_000722:B002/m01`); turning away by presenting one's side (`quranic:root_001001:B005/m01`); forced insertion into a medium or path (`quranic:root_000735:B002/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The exact route-root carries the scene across the boundary from description into consequence. P1 identifies the courses that groups occupy and marks deviation from the just line. P2 asks how a subject stands on that route and makes orientation causal: straightness opens sustaining flow, while presenting the side triggers insertion into difficulty. Collective classification thus becomes trajectory and outcome.

parent_channels.name: S10. P1 (72:6) to P2 (72:18-22): Borrowed Shelter Is Closed as a Category
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A client flees to a hidden patron and receives heavier pressure; the later sequence then removes calling, ownership of outcomes, protective jurisdiction, and even a lateral refuge from every secondary figure.
parent_channels.active_motifs: flight to a protector (`quranic:root_001059:B001/m01`); oppressive overburdening (`quranic:root_000606:B003/m01`); calling and inclining another through speech (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); legal possession and disposal (`quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`); granting asylum and preventing harm (`quranic:root_000275:B003/m01`); exhaustive negation of any eligible party (`quranic:root_000017:B002/m01`); an alternative other than the principal (`quranic:root_000502:B003/m01`); a refuge toward which one inclines (`quranic:root_001345:B003/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: P1 exposes the reversal within borrowed protection: the patron sought to reduce danger enlarges the client's burden. P2 does not replace that patron with a better intermediary. Exclusive calling, the messenger's disclaimer of possession, and the exhaustive absence of an asylum-holder close the secondary-protector role itself. What began as refuge through another ends as the denial that another can own, suspend, or shelter from the principal claim.

parent_channels.name: S11. P1 (72:10) to P2 (72:25-26): Two Unknown Futures Yield to the Knower of the Unseen
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A jinn speaker and the commanded messenger each face a binary question about a future outcome, mark the boundary of their role with the same admission of not-knowing, and yield the unresolved field to divine knowledge.
parent_channels.active_motifs: knowledge and making known (`quranic:root_000473:B001/m01`); intention and volition (`quranic:root_000610:B001/m01`); temporal approach and ripening (`quranic:root_001212:B002/m01`); concealment from sight and human knowledge (`quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`); knowledge opposed to ignorance (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge repeats more than a topic: both speakers use the same knowledge-root to refuse certainty about a future framed by alternatives. The first cannot infer intention from the closed sky; the second cannot infer timing from the promise. The next declaration changes the epistemic role rather than merely answering either question: knowledge of the unseen belongs to God, while finite speakers remain responsible for admitting the boundary of their knowledge.

parent_channels.name: S12. Whole-Surah: Rain Prayer Makes Water an Answer and a Test
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A petitioner asks God for rain, a respondent says "Amen," the first shower falls, and rain aids the land by watering it and bringing forth growth.
parent_channels.active_motifs: saying "Amen" to request a response (`quranic:root_000054:B003/m01`); supplication for rain and water (`quranic:root_000722:B006/m01`); the first shower and the pasture expected from it (`quranic:root_000566:B004/m01`); rain aiding a land by watering and germinating it (`quranic:root_001510:B004/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Request, assent, first fall, and germination form one response sequence. It materializes the abundant water of 72:16 as an answer directed to God rather than a resource procured through a secondary patron. The next ayah prevents the answer from becoming a warrant of privilege: supplied rain remains a test, and the rain that can act as "aid" to a land does not become the rival helper denied when the promised event arrives.

parent_channels.name: S13. Whole-Surah: A Rain-Fed Orchard Advances from Plowing to Renewal
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An orchard worker prepares fertile rain-fed ground with a coupled plow, tends dense growth through blossom and water-filled ripeness, cuts the yield, and observes drying followed by regrowth.
parent_channels.active_motifs: fertile ground in which plants establish and multiply (`quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`); a rain-fed field requiring no artificial irrigation (`quranic:root_000087:B003/m01`); an orchard enclosed by concealing trees (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); an orchard or vineyard worker (`quranic:root_000275:B005/m01`); paired yoke rods coupling oxen for plowing (`quranic:root_000741:B015/m01`); dense, tall, interlaced growth (`quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`); tree blossom (`quranic:root_001564:B004/m01`); fruit filling with water toward ripeness (`quranic:root_001458:B006/m01`); cutting and harvesting palms (`quranic:root_000227:B003/m01`); a crop nearing dryness while retaining some green (`quranic:root_000821:B005/m01`); regrowth after drying or loss (`quranic:root_000433:B010/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Water becomes a temporal cultivation process rather than a static possession. Soil must receive it, labor must order the field, and growth must pass through blossom, ripeness, cutting, drying, and possible renewal. This reframes 72:16-17 by locating the test throughout stewardship of a yield: abundance can mature into fruit, approach loss, or return after loss, so the initial supply does not by itself settle the field's outcome.

parent_channels.name: S14. Whole-Surah: Sweet Water Becomes an Unquenchable Internal Flood
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A drinker encounters abundant palatable water, drinks repeatedly without being quenched, reaches bodily refusal under severe thirst, and carries water pathologically within the abdomen.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a large gathered supply of sweet water (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m01`); sweet, palatable water or drink (`quranic:root_000994:B001/m01`); repeated excessive drinking without satiety (`quranic:root_000717:B005/m01`); bodily abstention from food and drink under severe thirst (`quranic:root_000994:B002/m01`); abdominal water and dropsy (`quranic:root_000722:B005/m01`); painful punishment (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene separates availability from right reception. External plenty and sweetness do not guarantee quenching; appetite can remain disordered until water is carried as internal affliction rather than received as provision. The same ع ذ ب field moves from sweetness and abstention to punishment, giving the transition from abundant water in 72:16 to trial and punishment in 72:17 a bodily mechanism.

parent_channels.name: S15. Whole-Surah: Scout and Lead Animal Order a Herd toward Water
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A scout searches ahead for pasture, a lead animal establishes direction, a driver gathers the scattered herd, and successive groups are moved toward the watering place at night.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a scout sent to seek pasture (`quranic:root_000610:B003/m01`); the lead animal followed by the rest (`quranic:root_001444:B008/m01`); gathering and driving a dispersed herd (`quranic:root_000372:B003/m01`); herds arriving in successive groups at pasture or water (`quranic:root_000563:B005/m01`); the night drive toward a watering place (`quranic:root_001212:B008/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Guidance is rendered as delegated coordination: one figure locates the resource, another gives the moving line its head, and enclosure converts scattered bodies into an ordered procession. None of those roles owns the pasture or water. The scene therefore materializes the distinction in 72:21-23 between functional guidance and proprietary agency: a messenger can orient and convey a collective toward provision without possessing its outcome.

parent_channels.name: S16. Whole-Surah: A Tanner Makes a Repairable Water Carrier
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hairy pelt is tanned with tree bark, cut into rawhide strips and a skin vessel, repaired with thick paste, and sewn inside a protective felt covering.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a pelt retaining its hair during skinning or tanning (`quranic:root_000844:B006/m01`); tannin-bearing tree bark or leaves (`quranic:root_000737:B008/m01`); rawhide strips and a skin vessel (`quranic:root_001204:B002/m01`); thick paste used to repair hide or waterskins (`quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`); a waterskin sewn into a felt cover (`quranic:root_001340:B004/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: The operation is the fabrication and maintenance of a carrier, not merely access to a source. Treatment stabilizes the hide, cutting gives it usable form, paste restores breaches, and felt protects the finished vessel. It materializes the custody implied by 72:16 and 72:23-28: abundant provision or entrusted content becomes transportable only through a bounded carrier whose integrity is actively maintained.

parent_channels.name: S17. Whole-Surah: A Loaded Ship Is Guided until Water Crosses Its Boundary
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A tarred cargo ship under a captain follows a visible marker toward shore with a small tender in attendance, while the water that bears it can also enter and endanger the vessel.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a tarred ship (`quranic:root_000973:B005/m02`); a loaded ship (`quranic:root_000050:B003/m02`); the head of the sailors (`quranic:root_000532:B017/m01`); a small attendant boat used for a ship's needs (`quranic:root_001212:B011/m01`); sea or river shore (`quranic:root_000227:B006/m01`); a visible route marker or beacon (`quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`); water entering a ship (`quranic:root_001458:B002/m02`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Cargo, captain, marker, tender, and shore make delivery a bounded navigation task. Water is simultaneously the medium that permits passage and the substance that compromises the vessel when it crosses the hull. That reversal usefully joins the surah's two primary operations: the abundance of 72:16 is itself a trial, while the entrusted delivery of 72:23 and 72:27-28 depends on maintained boundaries rather than on the carrier's ownership of route or cargo.

parent_channels.name: S18. Whole-Surah: An Offering Is Conveyed as Nearness, Not Partnership
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A worshipper dedicates an animal, property, or other offering as a means of approach and conveys it toward the sanctuary.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sacrificial offering and approach to God (`quranic:root_001212:B005/m01`); livestock or property dedicated and conveyed to the sanctuary (`quranic:root_001583:B005/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Nearness is enacted through a directed transfer: an object leaves ordinary disposal and is carried toward a sacred destination. The rite clarifies the exclusivity of 72:18-20 because the offering is a medium of approach, not a second recipient or partner. Guidance can orient the transfer and nearness can name its purpose without granting the conveyed object any share in divine agency.

parent_channels.name: S19. P1 (72:2-3,14-15) to P2 (72:18-21,27-28): Measured Coin Cannot Turn a Royal Image into Sovereignty
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A coin is valued, checked for equal weight, supplemented when its dirham amount is deficient, passed hand to hand, and then misused when people prostrate before the ruler pictured on it.
parent_channels.active_motifs: lordship, possession, and command (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); sovereignty and rule (`quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`); a fixed measure (`quranic:root_001224:B007/m01`); valuation and pricing (`quranic:root_001273:B010/m01`); an equal-weight dinar (`quranic:root_001273:B015/m01`); the amount that completes deficient dirhams (`quranic:root_000372:B008/m01`); hand-to-hand cash transfer (`quranic:root_001693:B007/m01`); pictured dirhams before which prostration is made to the represented king (`quranic:root_000675:B006/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Weight, valuation, supplementation, and cash transfer establish the coin's exact economic function; the ruler's image establishes only representation. Prostration wrongly converts those limited functions into divine title. The bridge therefore distinguishes being measurable, exchangeable, and politically marked from being sovereign: P1 denies a share in lordship, P2 reserves bodily worship and ownership of outcomes, and the final count measures every item without venerating any image it bears.

parent_channels.name: S20. Whole-Surah: A Poem Can Be Improvised, Measured, Faulted, and Sent
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A poet improvises a composition, models it on an earlier poem, submits it to prosodic measure, produces a defective or stray line, and sends praise or satire to an addressee.
parent_channels.active_motifs: an improvised speech or poem made without preparation (`quranic:root_000546:B011/m01`); a poem made on the pattern of another (`quranic:root_001210:B011/m01`); poetic meter and prosody (`quranic:root_001001:B014/m01`); a verse carrying a metrical defect (`quranic:root_001244:B017/m01`); a wild word or stray rhyme (`quranic:root_000004:B008/m01`); praise or satire composed and sent to another (`quranic:root_001583:B011/m01`).
parent_channels.synthesis: Pattern, meter, improvisation, defect, and dispatch form a complete human production chain for memorable speech. It usefully pressures the opening act of hearing and the closing act of delivery: formal wonder and successful address can be manufactured, imitated, or flawed. The primary reading therefore rests not on verbal pattern alone but on guidance, authorized source, guarded passage, and complete conveyance.
